CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_app_context()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, display_name text, system_role text, pharmacy_id uuid, pharmacy_code text, pharmacy_name text, member_role text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select
        u.id,
        u.email,
        case when coalesce(pr.display_name_verified,false) and nullif(trim(pr.display_name),'') is not null
             then pr.display_name
             else split_part(coalesce(u.email,''),'@',1)
        end,
        case when exists(select 1 from public.system_owners o where o.user_id=u.id) then 'owner'::text else null::text end,
        p.id,p.code,p.name,m.role
    from auth.users u
    left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=u.id
    left join lateral (
        select m1.* from public.pharmacy_members m1
        join public.pharmacies p1 on p1.id=m1.pharmacy_id
        where m1.user_id=u.id and m1.active=true and p1.status='active'
        order by m1.created_at limit 1
    ) m on true
    left join public.pharmacies p on p.id=m.pharmacy_id
    where u.id=auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pharmflow_auth_private.current_pharmacy()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT m.pharmacy_id FROM public.pharmacy_members m JOIN public.pharmacies p ON p.id=m.pharmacy_id
 WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active AND p.status='active'
 ORDER BY m.created_at,m.pharmacy_id LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pharmflow_auth_private.data_allowed(pid uuid, writing boolean DEFAULT false, global_write boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT pharmflow_auth_private.password_change_complete() AND
 (public.is_system_owner() OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.pharmacy_members m JOIN public.pharmacies p ON p.id=m.pharmacy_id
 JOIN public.pharmflow_pharmacy_permissions_v1 a ON a.pharmacy_id=p.id
 WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.pharmacy_id=pid AND m.active AND p.active AND p.status='active'
 AND (NOT writing OR (m.role='admin' AND a.data_access=ANY(
 CASE WHEN global_write THEN ARRAY['PHARMACY_GLOBAL'] ELSE ARRAY['PHARMACY_ONLY','PHARMACY_GLOBAL'] END)))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pharmflow_auth_private.module_allowed(pid uuid, mod text, writing boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT pharmflow_auth_private.password_change_complete() AND
 (public.is_system_owner() OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.pharmacy_members m JOIN public.pharmacies p ON p.id=m.pharmacy_id
 JOIN public.pharmflow_pharmacy_permissions_v1 a ON a.pharmacy_id=p.id
 WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.pharmacy_id=pid AND m.active AND p.active AND p.status='active'
 AND CASE mod WHEN 'RECEIVING' THEN a.receiving WHEN 'EXPIRY' THEN a.expiry ELSE 'DISABLED' END
 =ANY(CASE WHEN writing THEN ARRAY['FULL'] ELSE ARRAY['FULL','READ_ONLY'] END)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pharmflow_auth_private.password_change_complete()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'auth'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u
  WHERE u.id=auth.uid()
   AND coalesce(u.raw_app_meta_data->>'pharmflow_must_change_password','false')<>'true'
   AND coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'exp')::numeric,0)>extract(epoch from now())
   AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM auth.sessions s
    WHERE s.id=nullif(auth.jwt()->>'session_id','')::uuid
     AND s.user_id=u.id
     AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>now())
   )
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pharmflow_auth_private.global_allowed()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN nullif(current_setting('pharmflow.permission_pharmacy',true),'') IS NOT NULL
 THEN pharmflow_auth_private.data_allowed(current_setting('pharmflow.permission_pharmacy')::uuid,true,true)
 ELSE pharmflow_auth_private.password_change_complete() AND (public.is_system_owner() OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.pharmacy_members m JOIN public.pharmacies p ON p.id=m.pharmacy_id
 JOIN public.pharmflow_pharmacy_permissions_v1 a ON a.pharmacy_id=p.id
 WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active AND m.role='admin' AND p.active AND p.status='active' AND a.data_access='PHARMACY_GLOBAL')) END;
$function$
